title: Poor quality control
text: Poor quality control. Initially I ordered the blue dish towels.  They were of good density and absorbency.  Two of them were cut crooked.  Next I ordered the gray ones.  Disappointing.  All were cut crooked, all were thinner and all had pin sized holes in the striping.  Instead of returning them I have added to the pile for house  and car cleaning.  I love microfiber dish towels and dish cloths but next time it will be from another company.
